en.牌局、电脑对手和决策复盘在设备上计算。人数、难度、语言、对手风格、声音与提示保存: Hands, computer opponents and decision reviews run on your device. Table size, difficulty, language, opponent styles, sound and hints are stored locally and are not uploaded to the publisher. The current hand is kept only in running memory. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data removes local settings; restoring a system backup may restore them.
en.应用无账号、广告、追踪或分析服务，也不向发行者上传个人数据。核心练习无需联网。用: The app has no accounts, ads, tracking or analytics services, and does not upload personal data to the publisher. Core practice works offline. Opening a source or help link visits a third-party website in the system browser; that website’s privacy policy applies to the visit.
en.买断购买由 Apple App Store 或 Google Play 处理，本: Apple App Store or Google Play handles the upfront purchase. This app does not receive payment card information. All chips are virtual, have no cash value and cannot be purchased or redeemed. There are no prizes or real-money wagers.
en.当你主动通过邮件联系发行者时，发行者会收到你的邮箱地址和你提供的内容，仅用于回复: If you contact the publisher by email, the publisher receives your email address and the information you send, solely to reply, investigate and resolve the issue. Do not send passwords, payment details or unnecessary sensitive information. Unnecessary support information is not retained after the issue is resolved. You may request access or deletion at the email address above. Email providers process messages under their own policies.
en.电脑策略、参数、行动、思考时间和情绪均为合成训练机制，不代表任何真人的完整打法、: Computer strategies, parameters, actions, thinking times and moods are synthetic training mechanisms. They do not represent a real person’s complete strategy, mental state or professional skill. Public sources do not imply participation, cooperation, recommendation or endorsement by a person or event organizer. Citations and disclaimers do not grant permission to use names, photos or trademarks.
en.复盘使用行动发生前可见的信息和假设对手范围进行估算，不用对手隐藏底牌、后续发牌或: Reviews estimate decisions from information available before the action and assumed opponent ranges. They do not grade your decisions using opponents’ hidden cards, future cards or final winners, and do not guarantee optimal play or profit.
en.改变数据处理方式时，发行者会更新本政策及相应商店申报。你可通过本页面所列邮箱联系: The publisher will update this policy and store disclosures if data handling changes. Contact the publisher at the email address on this page.

en.获得部分底池，整手净亏损: Won part of the pot; net loss on the hand
en.本轮加注权未重开，仅可跟注或弃牌。: Raising has not reopened. You may only call or fold.
en.轮到你了，可以过牌或主动下注。: Your turn. You may check or bet.
en.短全下不会重开已有行动者的加注权: A short all-in does not reopen raising for players who have already acted.
en.本手净变化不包含之前累计的输赢。: Net change for this hand excludes previous hands.
en.摊牌 · 对手亮出底牌: Showdown · Opponents reveal their hole cards
en.练习补牌 · 五张公共牌，不影响结算: Practice runout · Five board cards; settlement is unchanged
en.本地德州扑克练习。所有筹码均为虚拟筹码，无现金兑换、奖金或真人赌注。: Local Texas Hold'em practice. All chips are virtual, with no cash redemption, prizes or real-money wagers.
en.牌局和复盘在设备上计算；本应用没有账号、广告、追踪或分析服务。: Hands and reviews run on your device. This app has no accounts, ads, tracking or analytics services.
en.人数、难度、对手风格、声音和提示设置仅保存在此设备，不上传到本应用服务器；当前牌: Table size, difficulty, opponent styles, sound and hints are stored on this device and are not uploaded. The current hand exists only in running memory.
en.仅当你主动打开资料来源或帮助链接时，系统浏览器会访问对应网站，第三方按其自身隐私: The system browser visits a website only when you choose to open a source or help link. Third parties process the visit under their own privacy policies.
en.这是无需登录的无限注德州扑克练习。先了解怎么赢、怎么行动，再用复盘和不同对手练习: Practice no-limit Texas Hold'em without an account. Learn how to win and act, then improve your decisions through reviews and different computer opponents.
en.每人两张底牌，桌上最多发出五张公共牌。从这七张牌中任选五张组成最好的牌，可以用两: Each player receives two hole cards, and up to five community cards are dealt. Make the best five-card hand using any combination of these seven cards: two, one or none of your hole cards. If everyone else folds, the remaining player wins the pot. At showdown, compare the best five-card hands.
en.牌型从强到弱：同花顺 → 四条 → 葫芦 → 同花 → 顺子 → 三条 → 两对: Hand rankings: straight flush → four of a kind → full house → flush → straight → three of a kind → two pair → one pair → high card
en.同一牌型先比组成牌型的点数，再比剩余牌的点数（踢脚）。最佳五张完全相同就平分，花: For equal categories, compare the ranks making the hand, then the kickers. Identical best five-card hands split the pot; suits have equal rank. An ace may be high or low in an A2345 straight.
en.小盲先投入 25，大盲先投入 50，其他人依次决定是否参与。翻牌前、翻牌、转牌、: The small blind posts 25 and the big blind posts 50. Players then act in order. There is a betting round preflop, on the flop, turn and river. Move to the next round after all players able to act have matched the bet or folded. The hand ends early if only one player remains.
en.跟注旁的数字是这次要补的筹码；加注旁的数字是这一轮累计投入的总额。例如你已投 5: Call shows the additional chips to pay; raise shows your total bet for this round. If you have posted 50 and an opponent raises to 150, calling adds 100. Raising to 300 adds 250. All chip amounts are multiples of 25.
en.BTN 是庄位，顺时针下一家是 SB（小盲），再下一家是 BB（大盲）。翻牌前从: BTN is the dealer button. Clockwise, the next seat is SB (small blind), followed by BB (big blind). Preflop action starts after the big blind. Postflop action starts with the first player able to act clockwise from the button. Later position lets you see more actions first. The button advances one seat after each hand.
en.最小下注为 50。完整加注的增量不能小于本轮上一次完整下注或加注的增量。例如上一: The minimum bet is 50. A full raise must increase the bet by at least the last full bet or raise increment. If a player raises from 50 to 150, the increment is 100 and the next minimum raise is to 250. With fewer chips, you may go all-in, but a short all-in may not reopen raising for players who have already acted.
en.全下后只能争夺自己有投入的部分。筹码多的人继续下注会形成边池，各池分别比较；弃牌: An all-in player can win only the pots they contributed to. Further betting may create side pots, settled separately. Folded contributions remain in the pot, but folded players are ineligible to win. Uncalled excess is refunded; a refund is not an additional award.
en.EV 是长期重复一种打法的预期筹码收益，一次赢牌不能证明长期赚钱。复盘根据你行动: EV is the expected chip return when a strategy is repeated over time; winning one hand does not prove positive long-term EV. Reviews use before-action information and assumed opponent ranges. They do not grade choices using hidden opponent cards or future cards, and do not guarantee optimal play or a win. Switch to Opponent reasoning to inspect the computer’s actual decision trace.
en.“重打这手牌”保留原底牌、庄位、起始筹码和发牌顺序，从翻牌前重新选择。原结算与统: Replay this hand restores the original hole cards, button, starting stacks and deck order. It retracts the previous payouts and statistics and uses the latest result. Computers respond to your new choices. Since you already know some cards, replay is useful for practice but cannot prove long-term EV. Next hand starts a new deal.
en.需要权益 = 有效跟注成本 ÷ 跟注后你可争夺的底池。主池与边池按参与资格分别估: Required equity = effective call cost ÷ the pots you can contest after calling. Main and side pots are estimated by eligibility. Uncalled refunds are not winnings.
en.只使用决策发生时的底牌、公共牌、公开行动和筹码。对手隐藏底牌、后续发牌和最终赢家: Uses only your hole cards, the board, public actions and stacks at the time. Hidden opponent cards, future cards and final winners do not enter decision grading.
en.获池包括平分或拿到部分底池，不等于净盈利；这里只显示抽样比例，不能当作真实胜率。: Winning a pot share includes splits and partial awards, and does not imply net profit. These are sample proportions, not true win rates.
en.这个旧快照缺少完整行动状态，无法进行后续行动模拟；保留公开信息的范围与价格分析。: This older snapshot lacks the full action state for a continuation simulation. Public-information range and price analysis is retained.
en.范围或抽样误差可能改变排序，暂未确认另一动作更好。: Range assumptions or sampling error may change the ranking. No better alternative has been confirmed.
en.配对比较支持一个比实际操作更好的候选；仍依赖模拟范围和后续策略。: Paired comparisons support an alternative to the actual action. The conclusion still depends on simulated ranges and continuation strategies.
en.候选动作共享抽样牌局，使用同一规则打到结算，比较收益与获池机会。后续采用模拟策略: Candidates share sampled deals and use the same rules through settlement to compare chip returns and pot-share outcomes. Continuations are simulated strategies, not optimal play. Sampling guard bands do not cover range or strategy errors. A simulation candidate is prioritized only when both ranges support improvement; otherwise it remains conditional. This is not a GTO solver and does not guarantee a win.
en.对手解释在结算后读取实际执行记录，说明它当时的价格、范围、情绪与随机分支；这些私: Opponent explanations inspect the execution trace after settlement: prices, ranges, synthetic moods and random branches. These private records do not enter grading of your decisions.
